description: Outro is a digital clinic for coming off antidepressants. Most people who want to stop have no real clinical support for how to do it. Outro builds a personalized taper around hyperbolic dosing, the method its team helped pioneer and codify in the Maudsley Deprescribing Guidelines, and pairs it with prescribers and coaching across the full year-plus it can take to do this safely.

Subquadratic builds frontier AI models that reason across millions of tokens at a fraction of the compute. Their architecture, Subquadratic Sparse Attention, reads only the relationships that matter, so one model can hold an entire codebase, a decade of filings, or a full patient history in a single pass.
